title: Post-Study Work Permits Across Europe
script: Welcome to TalentXcel Career Intelligence. Staying and working in Europe after earning your international degree. Top priorities include Germany: 18-Month Jobseeker Permit, France: 12-Month APS Visa, and Direct Pathway to EU Blue Card. PR Eligibility reaches 21 to 27 Months in Germany. Explore verified opportunities at talentxcel dot com today.
